products.name: Obscura Index Vault Zero
products.summary: Work the night shift in a haunted archive. Examine evidence, listen to recovered recordings and classify the anomalies before they find you.
products.alt: The dimly lit archive office in Obscura Index Vault Zero

products.name: The Ninth Life
products.summary: A VRChat bar, club and social venue with a companion website for events, tickets and member access.
products.alt: Official The Ninth Life venue banner
products.detail: Explore scheduled events through the venue’s website. General entry to the VRChat world does not require a venue website account. The member portal uses Discord sign-in.

products.name: StatePulse RP
products.summary: A citywide FiveM roleplay project with civilian jobs, emergency services and an in-game economy.
products.detail: StatePulse RP is being built on FiveM. The project brings together civilian work, policing, emergency response and businesses across the city.

products.name: TrapDoor
products.summary: A Discord honeypot bot that catches spam bots and bad actors in a clearly marked trap channel. When a non-exempt account posts there, TrapDoor automatically bans it and records the action in a private moderation log.

products.name: EDProLight
products.summary: Windows software that links the Saitek and Logitech X52 Pro joystick to Elite Dangerous. Its button lights and display show live ship information.
products.detail: EDProLight uses Logitech or Saitek DirectOutput to control the joystick LEDs and multifunction display. The repository includes download instructions and configuration options.

products.name: KawaiiNeko
products.summary: A BetterDiscord theme from the Workshop. See the project repository for installation information and updates.
products.detail: Use the theme repository for installation instructions, version information and issue reporting.

products.name: Workshop Launcher
products.summary: Browse Workshop games, redeem invitations and manage downloads and updates in one Windows app.
products.alt: Workshop Launcher interface with game and library shortcuts
